comment: SPIKE (WP-2). The one bmlib pin for both apps: the commit that built BmlibFFI.xcframework and Sources/BmlibCore/bmlib_ffi.swift (bmlib's rust/bmlib-ffi/scripts/build-xcframework.sh) and generated android/MedicalFactChecker/app/src/main/java/org/bmlib/ffi/bmlib_ffi.kt. All three are regenerated together, from one bmlib commit; a binding generated from another commit fails UniFFI's checksum check at first call. Android's Gradle cargo tasks read bmlibCommit from this file and refuse a bmlib checkout at any other commit (override: -Pbmlib.allowUnpinnedCommit=true). treeSha256 is defined and computed by treeSha256Script; run it with --check on this file. The xcframework and bmlib_ffi.swift are the bmlib-xcframework workflow's own build (xcode is that runner's), which every PR rebuilds and compares; its header says how to re-pin (#583).
